verdict.rationale: Honcho documents that its core is open source and can be self-hosted, letting users keep their data on their own infrastructure (`honcho start` runs the full stack via Docker). That gives users first-party control over where their data lives, but nothing in the evidence explicitly addresses AI training use. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or training opt-out for the hosted service, documentation on how data sent to underlying model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) is handled for training, and independent corroboration.
